passage:
Recycling plays an important role in protecting the environment and reducing pollution. Every year, millions of tons of waste are produced around the world, and much of this waste ends up in landfills or oceans. Recycling helps reduce the amount of garbage by turning used materials into new products.

Common recyclable materials include paper, plastic, glass, and metal. Reusing these materials can conserve natural resources and reduce energy consumption during manufacturing. For example, producing recycled aluminum requires far less energy than creating new aluminum from raw materials.

Despite its benefits, recycling systems still face challenges in many countries. Some communities lack proper recycling facilities, while others struggle with low public participation. Environmental experts believe that education and government support are essential for improving recycling efforts and encouraging more sustainable lifestyles.
